No clones yet. Tap + Add new app to pick an app, then name the clone.

Generic multi-account container (not Muse-only). It does NOT contain, bundle, modify or re-sign any target APK. You supply an app — as an APK file or from the apps already installed on this phone — and each clone keeps its own login and data.
Target for simultaneous online: 3-4. Active here means you marked it active — it does NOT mean a guest Muse process is running yet.

Why: Android/Samsung kill background apps. Exemption + a foreground service are required for continuous notifications, but they do NOT guarantee Android will never kill a clone — that must be tested on the real phone.\nThe Keep-alive button only keeps a host foreground service alive; it does not by itself deliver or label per-clone notifications.

- A bubble is a SHORTCUT ICON ONLY. It does NOT show chat content inside the bubble.
- Bubble and fast-switch toggles below default OFF, per clone. Bubbles appear only for ACTIVE clones.
- Drag a bubble to the red strip at the bottom of the screen to hide it (this turns that clone's bubble toggle OFF).
- Fast switching reuses the engine launch path: the target clone opens logged in (guest data is per virtual user), but the engine has NO bring-to-front API, so the exact foreground screen may be recreated. Verify on the phone.
Notifications: guest notifications are posted through the engine\'s notification proxy, not reposted by this host. Verify delay per clone on a real phone.

This VPN strip is UI only for now: no VPN backend is working yet and there is no WireGuard configuration. The Connect button is disabled until a server configuration exists. No Connected status or fake IP is shown. Choosing a country only saves the choice for later use; it changes nothing on the network.

Why this permission: bubbles and the fast-switch button must float above other apps, including inside a clone. Without it Android will not show them at all. Allow \'Display over other apps\' for Muse Container, then come back here.
